content: The exhaust manifold collects exhaust gases from the cylinder head and routes them to the exhaust pipe. A cracked or leaking manifold causes ticking noises, loss of power, and false lean O2 readings. Inspect for cracks, warpage, and leaking gaskets.

The muffler reduces exhaust noise using baffles and sound-absorbing material. A failing muffler causes increased exhaust noise, rust holes, or restricted flow. Inspect for rust, holes, and loose hangers.
The resonator fine-tunes exhaust tone and reduces specific frequencies. A damaged resonator causes unusual exhaust noise. Inspect for rust, holes, or loose mounting.
